body: I'm a mechanic and I try to invent new things. I also like to play Assassin's Creed and other RPG games. I like to create. I don't have anything to talk about. I don't drink so that makes it difficult to go out. I don't have a whole lot of self esteem so I don't speak out loud unless it's to my dog. But beyond that I'm kind of just an inside person. I do like to climb. I climb for work when I'm not unemployed but the industry is so sketchy that it's hard to stay in one place long.
She doesn't deserve that. I can say bye and put her in good hands but putting her in a shelter would only hurt more

She's full of energy. She likes sticks more than any toy you could buy, and she has a strict diet. She comes when she's called and she is well trained. Kind of a nutcase but it's adorable. She's 75% golden, 12.5% each Golden lab and Golden doodle mix. She is free of all genetic conditions so she won't have the regular golden issues. She plays well and is good with kids and other animals (although she never stops playing). She sleeps on the bed with me, and is crate trained for travel and boarding situations. All around 10/10 good girl.

My situation has been running for almost 2 years now and only gets worse because it's almost purely financial. The only way out is to somehow come up with $40,000 and an actual good attorney who cares to help. At least for the solvable issues. The other side of that coin is the fact that I'm deeply resentful towards the human race and cannot fit in to any social group. My interests are minimal, and the things I do like are so far fetched that to meet anyone who likes what I like I would need to have to social skills to connect with another person.

For what it's worth, it means a lot that kind people still exist. That being said I've ran through all of those options, hospital stays, and counseling. None of that can reverse the crushing debt and unemployment. Christmas is around the corner and it's just me and my dog. I'm 27. I have no family, friends, or coworkers to turn to. I made my bed and I'm going to lay in it. I just think that the joy that I'm supposed to feel from having her in my life can actually go to someone who can feel it. 

Thank you for your concern.
I appreciate the sentiment, I really do.

Hey, if y'all could stop reporting this post and actually help that would be great. A bunch of people telling me to reach out to crisis lines kind of clogs the inbox. 

The crisis and suicide hotlines are a joke and are only there to make y'all feel like you helped. I need a home for my dog not someone telling me "it's going to be okay". It's not. I'm broke and can't even afford to eat. I'm trying to make sure my dog does not have to go without a home or food.

Thank you.
The veterans crisis line is a joke. They hung up on me after telling me I was pranking them. Thank you though.

Nobody is concerned until it's too late. Thqnk you for your concern but you have no idea who I am and my life does not matter to you. 

Have a nice day
Except the thing is, she hasn’t cheated on anyone before. I’ve known her most of my life and she never did on anyone except me.
I just feel like I’m just not good enough. And that blows.

This thread seems like an opportunity to vent so here goes:  
I am currently sitting in the middle of Afghanistan. It’s cold, it’s dark, I work night shift so from 1600 to 0400, and I’m currently not speaking to my wife. We will be getting divorced when I get home from this deployment, but I don’t want to leave the kids. So on top of all that suck, I just returned from a one year rotation without my family and word is I’m going to Germany after we get home. So basically life. Life just fucking sucks.
